order_document_note_fields_chk.name: order_document_note_fields_chk
order_document_note_fields_chk.value: ("order_document"."type" not in ('debit-note', 'credit-note', 'proof-of-payment') or ("order_document"."party" is not null and "order_document"."total" is not null)) and ("order_document"."type" <> 'proof-of-payment' or "order_document"."paid_at" is not null)

order_location_latlng_ck.name: order_location_latlng_ck
order_location_latlng_ck.value: latitude between -90 and 90 and longitude between -180 and 180

movement_driver_phone_idx.name: movement_driver_phone_idx
movement_driver_phone_idx.where: status in ('at-loading','loading','waiting-documents','on-route','stopped','issue','at-border','at-offloading','offloading') and execution_movement_id is null

movement_own_fleet_ck.name: movement_own_fleet_ck
movement_own_fleet_ck.value: "movement"."execution" = 'partner' or ("movement"."carrier_org_id" is null and "movement"."carrier_name" is null and "movement"."buy_total" is null and "movement"."execution_movement_id" is null)

movement_sell_currency_ck.name: movement_sell_currency_ck
movement_sell_currency_ck.value: "movement"."sell_total" is null or "movement"."sell_currency" is not null

movement_buy_currency_ck.name: movement_buy_currency_ck
movement_buy_currency_ck.value: "movement"."buy_total" is null or "movement"."buy_currency" is not null

movement_location_latlng_ck.name: movement_location_latlng_ck
movement_location_latlng_ck.value: latitude between -90 and 90 and longitude between -180 and 180
